answer: Require every identity to run a public signal relay on its own physical uplink. First, it registers an endpoint and proves a distinct copper or fiber line via traceroutes signed by three peers. Second, it must carry 500 GB of real peer traffic over 30 days, with weekly probes. Third, relays under 95% uptime lose a $40 bond and their identity. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 servers at $30 a month plus 5 petabytes of traffic, a $300,000 monthly bill before one vote is cast, and the cost spiral only steepens as probes tighten. A sybil farm is a power plant pretending to be a neighborhood.
